title: How the agent works
label: An AI agent's run drawn as five numbered steps on a rail. A token labelled Request 2041 travels from step to step: read request shows the customer's message, make a plan shows three ticked steps, call tools shows three tool calls, check the result shows an 84 dollar refund issued, and the last step, answer, lands the result: answered in 38 seconds with two sources cited.
heading:
Every answer shows
its work.
sub: The agent reads, plans, calls your tools and checks the result before it replies. Each step is logged.

steps.title: Read request
steps.detail: Understand what the customer is asking for.

steps.title: Make a plan
steps.detail: Break the request into steps it can check.

steps.title: Call tools
steps.detail: Use the systems you connected, nothing else.

steps.title: Check result
steps.detail: Confirm the action matches the policy.

steps.title: Answer
steps.detail: Reply in plain words, with the sources.
